question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Eccentric
solution: The correct answer is '**Queer**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct meaning of the word '**Eccentric**' is strange or unusual.(अजीब या असामान्य) • The meaning of the word '**Queer**' is strange or odd from a conventional viewpoint; unusually different.(एक पारंपरिक दृष्टिकोण से अजीब; असामान्य रूप से भिन्न।) • Hence, the correct synonym for the word '**Eccentric**' is '**Queer**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the other word's meaning; • **Excellent**: very good; of high quality. (बहुत अच्छा; उच्च गुणवत्ता का।) • **Common**: happening or found often or in many places; usual.(अक्सर या कई जगहों पर होता या पाया जाता है; सामान्य) • **Charming**: very pleasing or attractive.(बहुत मनभावन या आकर्षक) 37:T8ed, The correct answer is 'Pamplet'.
